business_problem: GM needed deeper visibility into supply-chain vulnerabilities and a stronger ability to anticipate, mitigate, and respond to supplier and facility disruptions after the semiconductor supply chain crisis exposed weaknesses in its global network.
solution_summary: General Motors built an in-house digital supply chain toolset, launched in 2022 with supplier cooperation, to anticipate disruptions across its global manufacturing network. Risk Intelligence ingests thousands of daily public posts and applies AI and machine learning to classify, summarize, and tag signals such as natural disasters and other disruption indicators. SupplyHealth works with supply partners to monitor thousands of sites and flag high-risk situations before escalation. SupplyMap gathers supplier-provided data from direct suppliers and lower-tier sources to create a map-based view of the network so teams can see dependencies and where risks may emerge. When a risk is identified, SupplyAlert combs internal GM data and routes prioritized alerts to responsible team members for pre-emptive action. The source does not name a storage platform, but it clearly describes external signal ingestion, supplier network mapping, internal data analysis, and coordinated human response.

solution_components.name: Risk Intelligence

solution_components.name: SupplyHealth
solution_components.role: Monitors supplier-related sites and flags high-risk situations so teams can intervene before issues escalate.

solution_components.name: SupplyMap
solution_components.role: Collects supplier network data and builds a detailed map-based view of GM's multi-tier supply chain.

solution_components.name: SupplyAlert
solution_components.role: Centralizes risk communications by combing through internal data and flagging key risks to team members for pre-emptive action.

data_flow: Public posts, supplier-provided site data, multi-tier supplier network information, and GM internal data feed GM's in-house toolset. Risk Intelligence classifies and tags external disruption signals, SupplyHealth monitors supplier sites, and SupplyMap assembles supplier network data into a map-based view. Once risk is detected, SupplyAlert analyzes internal context and pushes alerts to GM supply chain team members so they can take pre-emptive action.
integration_points: Lower-tier suppliers in the value chain
business_outcome: The toolset improved visibility across GM's complex supply chain and enabled teams to mitigate risks faster and improve efficiency.
